articles.title: You Can Play WoW: Forever For Free Next Week (But There’s A Catch)
articles.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever's beta will be free for a limited time next week, giving players who want to check out the new version of Blizzard's old-school MMORPG but don't want to pay $60 for beta access a chance to see what all the hype is about.
body: Blizzard announced a WoW: Forever stress test will begin October 19 at 2 PM PT/ 5 PM ET, with no WoW subscription or beta access needed to play. The goal is to put the game's servers through their paces ahead of launch.
"This is a highly valuable event, since you'll participate in our discovering of issues that would have otherwise happened on launch day," Blizzard said in a post announcing the stress test.

To install the test, players will need the Battle.net launcher installed and an account. After selecting WoW: Forever from the list of games, players can select to install the stress test under the "Game Version" drop-down menu.

There is, however, a catch. The stress test will only run for a "few hours," according to Blizzard. Exactly how long the test will last is still unclear. Blizzard said the test window "may end earlier or run later as needed." During the time that the stress test is live, the game's closed beta will be offline, but will return following the conclusion of the test. All characters made during the stress test will be deleted once the test is over.

articles.title: This Espresso Machine Can Run Doom
articles.summary: Before caffeinating yourself in the morning, the Fellow Espresso Series 1 machine can actually run 1993's Doom on its small, circular screen. Reddit user FullExtraction showed off the classic FPS, utilizing the brew button to run and steam button to shoot.
body: There's also a wider-angle video of Doom working on the espresso machine, via custom firmware. The game looks pretty smooth in the snippet, showcasing a solid frame rate. Out of the box, that circular screen provides a user interface to choose what drink you're making--such as an americano, cappuccino, or even a straight shot of espresso. It will provide text directions as well as a timer for extraction, too. Or, apparently, you can blast some demons.

This espresso machine joins a long, long list of devices, games, and even potatoes that can run Doom. For instance, we saw how an Anker smart-charging station could play the game without any hardware modifications last year. Then, there's someone that modified a freakin' pregnancy test and got the FPS working on it. Last but not least, one of the biggest video games in Fortnite can run Doom, too.

In the meantime, the Darkhold Destiny Arcanum Bundle has an interesting collection content-wise, and whether it’s worth the price tag or not more or less depends on what you’re looking for.
Along with a Collector Booster (alt-art Arcanum promo cards and Full-Art Lands), you’ll also get eight regular Booster Packs inside Darkhold Destiny’s Arcanum Bundle.

If you’re the type of Magic: The Gathering collector who usually likes going after the fancier treatments — like source-material cards, silver foil versions, and Midnight Raised Foils, that’s already a nice extra bang for your hundred bucks.

articles.title: Shrek 2 Remaster Leaks, Looks Amazing And I Need It Now
articles.summary: A remaster of 2004's Shrek 2: The Game is on the way, according to an Xbox.com listing that seems to have been published too soon. The page for the unannounced game--which has since been removed--says the remaster will feature better textures, enhanced UI, and 4K resolution.
body: Like the original PS2, Xbox, and GameCube game, the remaster lets you play solo or in co-op with up to three friends, locally or online. The playable characters include Shrek, Fiona, and Donkey, among others.

In addition to the updated graphics, the Shrek 2 remaster includes a new Photo Mode and Cheat Mode. The original was published by Activision, but Aspyr Media is bringing this game to market. That company was also behind the recent The Lord of the Rings re-releases.

The Xbox page for the Shrek 2 remaster does not list a release date or a price. The game is expected to come to PlayStation as well, and Switch wouldn't be a surprise either. Aspyr should release it on November 19 to go up against GTA 6 in a heavyweight battle for the ages.

This game may have leaked through Xbox, but the official Shrek account posted a compilation of Shrek video game footage with the caption, "Only real gamers played Shrek," and many think it's connected to the Shrek 2 remaster. The compilation includes the OG Shrek 2 game, along with numerous others, including Shrek Smash N' Crash Racing and Shrek Super Party, the latter of which is one of Obsession star Inde Navarrette's favorite games.

articles.title: WoW: Forever Just Changed The Math On What Race To Play In A Big Way
articles.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever's beta is set to end in just a few days on October 21, but that hasn't stopped Blizzard from making some major changes to the game's various racial abilities.
body: Unlike in the modern version of WoW, where racial abilities are so minor that they mostly feel cosmetic, racial abilities in WoW Classic (and now in Forever) are a big part of why players choose to play a particular race. Some races synergise better with certain classes or playstyles. Others even benefit more from using specific types of weapons.

Or at least they used to. In Forever's latest beta update, developer Blizzard has overhauled many of the MMO's racial abilities to remove weapon-specific buffs and improve some abilities that were seen as lackluster by the community.

The removal of weapon-based passives for humans, dwarves, and orcs is a significant change. Orcs used to favor axes, humans swords and maces, and dwarves guns. In WoW Classic, that meant an increased weapon skill when using those weapons, resulting in a better chance to hit and increased damage.

articles.title: Nvidia App Update Will Let AI Agents Tune Your Graphics Card, but Some Users are Warning to Turn It Off
articles.summary: It's no secret that Nvidia loves its AI, and fresh off of launching RTX Spark – the new chipset for Agentic laptops – the Nvidia app now has a toggle that'll let AI agents control it. The problem is that it's turned on by default. Nvidia added the option in Nvidia App 11.0.9.565 on October 13.
body: It's not terribly surprising that Nvidia has added this option to the Nvidia app; after all, it did just debut its RTX Spark platform, which is built entirely around AI agents, so it makes sense that the Nvidia App would let users hook those agents in. But the setting isn't exclusive to RTX Spark systems and shows up for anyone who installs the latest version of the app.
And, of course, some people are upset and worried about the security implications of letting an AI agent control their graphics cards.

Silent Hill: Ascension cinematic director Agustin Cordes tweeted about the update, saying, "PSA: Can confirm that the Nvidia app is automatically updating and has *enabled by default* a setting which allows AI agents to control the app with very permissive rights. Besides the obnoxious privacy invasion and lame AI features, it's a high security risk you may not want."
Meanwhile, a swath of fans quoted his post, like user TheAcidBurns3, who says, "Please pay attention to this. You do NOT want your graphics card being accessed like this!"

articles.title: James McAvoy Reveals He Once Pitched a Young Picard Star Trek Show
articles.summary: James McAvoy revealed he pitched a Picard Star Trek show that would have seen him yet again star as a young Patrick Stewart. The Split and X-Men actor opened up about his love for Stewart's time in the Star Trek universe during a conversation on Happy, Sad, Confused.
body: Instead of stemming directly from his love for Star Trek or even Stewart's Next Generation captain, Jean-Luc Picard, it sounds like McAvoy's idea for a limited series also came from his connection to Stewart himself.

"Mutiny on the Stargazer: That was a whole idea I had that I pitched the Star Trek people, as well. Nearly did it," the actor teased. When pressed for an explanation, he said, "I've got a whole story about an early Picard. I mean, all I really want to do in my career is play young versions of Patrick."

That, of course, is a reference to McAvoy's time spent playing Charles Xavier in films like X-Men: First Class, Days of Future Past, Apocalypse, and Dark Phoenix. It's a character made famous in the movie world by Stewart's aged-up portrayal in the original 2000s X-Men trilogy, and considering most seem to think McAvoy nailed the part in his follow-ups, a part as a young Picard could definitely make sense, too.

Alas, the Picard prequel never took off. The actor explained that he developed a whole story for what would have been a one-off season of TV that he still loves to this day, but for now, at least, his time as a young Stewart will be limited to the Marvel universe.

articles.title: Every DC Studios Movie and TV Show in Coming Through 2028 (and Beyond)
articles.summary: There are still some lingering projects left over from the pre-Gunn era of the DCU, including a new Matt Reeves-led Batman movie and the fate of Peacemaker, the series starring John Cena that spanned two eras of DC film and television — and left fans contending with a major cliffhanger.
body: Since taking over the DC cinematic universe in 2022, DC Studios co-chairmen and CEOs James Gunn and Peter Safran have overhauled Warner Bros.' comic book-to-screen strategy. The new DCU officially launched in 2024 with the animated series Creature Commandos, and Gunn and Safran have since built out an all-new universe for the likes of Superman, Green Lantern, and Batman to play in. There have been ups and downs so far, as well as big shifts in Gunn's original vision for the DCU, which imagined a 10-year plan to explore the DC Universe across films, television, and video games.
So, what's next for the DCU? Here’s everything DC is currently planning to put in theaters and on TV screens, this year and well into the future.

Clayface, a solo outing for the venerable Batman villain, wasn’t originally in James Gunn and Peter Safran’s plans for the DCU. But writer and filmmaker Mike Flanagan ( Midnight Mass, Doctor Sleep ) nonetheless impressed the DCU heads with his “ horror-thriller-tragedy ” idea, and now we’re getting a Clayface movie!

articles.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 - Campaign Review
articles.summary: Modern Warfare 4 may not have quite enough to be considered amongst the very best Call of Duty campaigns, but if it’s to be the end of this particular saga, then at least it's going out on a high note.
body: These are our impressions of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4’s campaign. Reviews of DMZ and multiplayer will follow.

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's campaign has been set an unenviable task: tie the bow on a seven-year-long series of stories I’d politely describe as “uneven.” To its credit, it handles this challenge well, delivering a genuinely exciting string of missions that are great when they focus on what is new, rather than getting bogged down in the past. It’s the best Modern Warfare has been since its 2019 reboot by quite some distance, and a reminder of how good Call of Duty can be when the people making it are given time to cook.

articles.title: How to get the DLC weapons in Fire Emblem Fortune's Weave
articles.summary: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave 's DLC weapons give your army a sizeable advantage, though they do come with a few drawbacks. Obtaining the weapons involves completing a new subquest, and each of the four playable Flame Lords gets a special weapon.
body: These weapons are only available as part of the Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave expansion pass, and they've been added to the game as Wave 1 of the DLC.
Below, we explain how to get Fire Emblem Fortune's Weave 's DLC weapons and what to expect from them.

After you purchase and download Fortune's Weave 's expansion pass, you'll get an in-game notice about the new weapons. It mentions a subquest, but says nothing about what it is or where — or when — to find it. Here's how it works, though.

Each Flame Lord gets one of the new subquests, and the quest becomes available as soon as you get access to the bulletin board in Dagsion. That's roughly during Chapter 4, though when in that chapter depends on the character. Dietrich, for example, has to go through all the city tutorials and a few battles before the board unlocks. Cai does most of that in Chapter 3, so he gets to it faster.

articles.title: GTA 6 Recaptures What Made GTA’s Best DLC So Great
articles.summary: If there’s one word that describes GTA 6, it’s sexy. Since its debut trailer, the new open-world game appears to be a drastic detour from Rockstar’s previous entries, in its enhanced version of Vice City, and in the dynamic between its dual protagonists and how their steamy relationship informs the…
body: Of course, while utterly gorgeous and visually striking, those elements aren’t exactly unique to GTA 6. In fact, most of the trailers we’ve seen thus far bring to mind another Grand Theft Auto game that reveled in the same brand of excess, an expansion that feels increasingly relevant with every new look at Rockstar’s next open-world sandbox. Released in 2009 as the second and final DLC pack for GTA 4, The Ballad of Gay Tony traded the base game's grimy streets and bruised moral sensibilities for a gaudier vision of Liberty City, built around thumping nightclubs, champagne-soaked parties, luxury cars, and criminal escapades that grew ever-more ridiculous with each passing mission.
A weekly cheat sheet to what you’ll eventually love to play. No buying, no commitment — just saving for later.

The Ballad of Gay Tony gave us a glimpse into what Grand Theft Auto could look like when it stopped apologizing for its own absurdity and embraced the ride. If GTA 6 is determined to bring that unapologetically sexy edge back to the series as its trailers seem to suggest, there’s no better stage for it to thrive than Vice City.

articles.title: Analogue is reviving its Mega SG and Super Nt consoles, and they'll play all your old Sega and Nintendo cartridges with some modern enhancements
articles.summary: Analogue - creator of various fancy retro-focused game consoles - has detailed its newly announced Mega Sg+ and Super Nt+: revised editions of its earlier Mega Sg and Super Nt machines, capable of playing original Sega and Nintendo cartridges with modern advancements.
body: Analogue's first stab at the Super Nt launched in 2018, while the Mega Sg arrived one year later. Both machines' imminent upgrades feature, as per the company's announcement, "an FPGA designed in-house from scratch and backed by more than a decade of development. Rock solid. No emulation. Purpose-built 1080p for 2D gaming. Zero lag. Total accuracy."

As for compatibility, the Mega SG+ is said to be 100 percent compatible "with the 2,180+ Sega Genesis, Mega Drive, Master System, Game Gear, Mycard Adapter, Mark III/SG1000 game cartridge library", while the Super Nt+ is compatible with over 2,200 Super Nintendo and Super Famicom games.

Both consoles sport a redesigned "industrial" look, and support wireless controllers via bluetooth and 2.4GHz connectivity. Additionally, users can hot-swap cartridges without having to power down the machines - they simply need to quit their current game and switch them out. Furthermore, it's possible to power the consoles on and off using a controller now - and the required USB-C power supply and cable are included in the box.

articles.title: Street Fighter’s Best Live-Action Movie Yet Is Free on Streaming
articles.summary: The latest Street Fighter movie is out, and early reactions are not pretty. The film is currently sitting at 45% on Rotten Tomatoes and a 44 score on Metacritic. Polygon described it as an “incoherent, irredeemable mess” that flounders for an overlong two-hour runtime before ending in an…
body: If you’re in the mood for a bad live-action Street Fighter movie with a great M. Bison performance, but you don’t want to leave the house, here’s some good news: 1994’s Street Fighter is streaming for free on Tubi and Pluto TV.

Both critics and audiences panned this Jean-Claude Van Damme-helmed picture at release, calling it goofy and unfaithful to the source material. Still, it made $99.4 million at the box office on a $35 million budget. The film’s main redeeming quality is Raul Julia’s portrayal of M. Bison, who gave the villain a gravitas that helped turn the movie into a cult classic.

If there’s one obvious difference between this latest Street Fighter movie and the 1994 film, it’s that this 2026 version seems to have gone out of its way to portray its characters in a more “lore-accurate” way. While critics dug into the flick for what they described as emotionally empty fan service, it will be interesting to see how it lands with series die-hards, who may simply be happy to see Ryu, Ken, and Chun-Li punch guys while looking like their counterparts in the source material.

articles.title: 11 games and announcements that got us excited in the latest Galaxies Showcase
articles.summary: You can smell it in the air can't you? The chill in your nostrils and the earthy scent as leaves fall and the sun departs for another year. Yes, autumn is here, meaning we're teetering on the cavernous hole of near-nothingness as the entire games industry gives GTA 6 the widest berth imaginable.
body: I've been very excited about Bristol developer Friday Sundae's There are no Ghosts at the Grand ever since I saw it at a preview last year. It's one of those things that reads like a checklist of my very specific gaming interests, being part musical, part home renovation sim, and part ghostbusting mystery adventure, all unfolding in a dilapidated hotel in a British seaside town.

The idea is you've got 30 days to renovate it (exactly why is part of the mystery given its protagonist has motives so secret, he'll even try hiding them from the player), but there's plenty more to do besides: you can explore the cobblestone streets, go sailing out at sea, or take a scooter into the countryside as you attempt to uncover the truth about the hotel's strange past. By night, there are ghosts to deal with - and throughout all this, the cast is prone to bursting into song. And if that tickles your fancy in the same way it's tickling mine, you can play a Steam demo right now ahead of its December arrival.

articles.title: Fortnite is coming to Linux so we may soon be able to play it and other games like Apex Legends on Steam Deck and Steam Machine
articles.summary: Epic Games is officially working on bringing its battle royale shooter Fortnite to Linux. The announcement was tucked away at the bottom of Epic's widely mocked blog post revealing the new, "vibe-coded" Epic Games Store, which is also coming to Linux.
body: At the time, Epic explained it's going to be working with Linux distro maintainers on a set of security requirements needed to run Fortnite. Distros - short for distributions - are operating system variants of Linux, each with its own goals and prioritised system operations. Valve's SteamOS, for instance, is based on Arch Linux. Because of the many discrepancies between Linux distros, each would need to implement Epic's security requirements individually if they want Fortnite to run on their operating system. Fortnite will arrive on Linux via the EGS launcher, but only if a "critical mass of distro maintainers" is reached. Epic didn't specify numbers.

This is big news for several reasons. For one, the move would likely make Fortnite playable on SteamOS PCs and handhelds, including Steam Machine and Steam Deck. Furthermore, even if that "critical mass" is never reached, Epic says its work will be available to other developers interested in bringing their games to Linux.
points: Epic Games is officially working on bringing its battle royale shooter Fortnite to Linux.
